questions.question: Using show_regression, how trustworthy is the linear fit as a summary of the bulk of the points in the DiabetesPedigreeFunction versus Glucose analysis?

answer.value: The linear regression line is not a trustworthy summary of the bulk of the points. On the underlying DiabetesPedigreeFunction × Glucose data, the linear fit explains only about R² ≈ 0.02—the cloud is wide and Glucose varies greatly at similar pedigree values, so the red line cuts through a dispersed band rather than tracking a clear trend. Outcome-colored points span a large vertical range around the line; the line mainly captures a weak upward tilt, not the dominant structure of the view.

key_insights: Very low explained variance: the regression line leaves most variation in Glucose unexplained.
Visual impression matches a broad scatter with weak linear structure versus a tight band around the line.
